# Fix-It Saturday at St. Ansgar

**Bring your broken toaster—and stay for coffee.**

Our first Fix-It Saturday is coming to St. Ansgar, and the whole neighborhood is invited. Bring something that needs a little attention, and one of our volunteer fixers will take a look.

**Saturday, December 5, 2026**  
**9 a.m. to 1 p.m.**  
Fellowship Hall, St. Ansgar Lutheran Church  
Minneapolis, Minnesota  
Enter by the alley door; there’s a ramp.

It’s free. You don’t need to be a church member, and there’s no sign-up. Donations to the food shelf are welcome but not expected. This is good neighboring, plain and simple: no strings, and nobody will preach at you.

Our fixers so far can help with small appliances, lamps, bikes, clothing mending and knife sharpening. We also have a retired tech guy who can take a look at laptops and phones. Please bring **one item per person to start**, so we can keep the line moving. And whether you’re waiting for a repair or just stopping by, we’ll have coffee and kringle.

The idea began in the church kitchen, when Marv Okafor fixed my 1970s Hamilton Beach mixer in twenty minutes. I kept thinking about how much gets thrown away when all it needs is a screw or a new cord. Then Doris Lindqvist, who is 84 and has darned socks for this parish since the Carter years, asked to run the mending table herself. Council approved the idea last week, and I confess I’m thrilled.

After December 5, we’ll gather on the **first Saturday of every month through spring**.

**Want to be a fixer?** We’d love more volunteers, especially anyone who knows their way around vacuums or zippers. Contact the church office at **office@stansgarlutheran.example** or **612-555-0148**.

We hope to see you—and your toaster—there.
